resources.title: Agentic commerce liability is still being written
resources.note: Worldpay's view (2026-07-30): no agent liability shift exists yet; fraud on properly tokenized agent payments generally follows existing rules, while disputes short of fraud are unsettled. Visa's rules make the cardholder responsible within Visa's system. They also require issuers to pay for Agentic Transactions made under cardholder instructions, and from 2026-10-24 a provider's login ID counts among the evidence that can defeat a card-absent fraud dispute.
